intro: Sharptalon's Claw is a trophy quest representing the defeat of the ferocious hippogryph Sharptalon in Ashenvale. Taking the creature's severed talon back to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post proves your skill and protects Horde supply lines through the ancient forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The mighty hippogryph Sharptalon has been slain, with the claw of the felled beast serving as a testament to your victory. Senani Thunderheart at the Splintertree Post will no doubt be interested in seeing this trophy as proof of your deeds.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes, mighty adventurer, I sensed your arrival. I trust you have more news to report to me about your hunt?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Most impressive, friend... The claw of Sharptalon could not have been easy to get! The Ashenvale Hunt goes well for you!

Sharptalon had long terrorized the peons from the lumber camps near its path as they tried to travel here to Splintertree Post. No doubt once the word gets out that it was you who put down the beast, many rousing songs of your bravery will be heard at campfires and lumber mills across Ashenvale!
